searchLog: Infrastructure failure, not an honest zero, and the same failure as the prior run: this session's WebFetch can resolve www.anthropic.com only (confirmed getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, www.databricks.com, scale.com, stripe.com, openai.com, c3.ai, jobs.lever.co, jobs.generalcatalyst.com, www.google.com, www.linkedin.com — the session's network allowlist, not the sites, blocked them). Even anthropic.com's own individual job postings 307-redirect to job-boards.greenhouse.io, which also fails, so no single Anthropic posting's eligibility/deadline text could be confirmed either — only the static /careers/jobs listing page rendered (70 Applied AI Architect roles, all customer-facing with no stated new-grad track per target-companies.json; 24 TPM roles, none early-career; FAQ states 'we don't currently offer internships'; no Fellows Program page found at the expected path). WebSearch worked and surfaced plausible new-grad Forward-Deployed-Engineer leads (Palantir, Applied Intuition, C3.ai, Domino Data Lab, Northslope) explicitly open to December-2026 grads, but hunt.md's verification rule requires confirming open status, eligibility, and deadline from the live page itself, not a search snippet — and every one of those boards was unreachable. Also note: Northslope FDE is already a closed application per life/PIPELINE.md ('Not moved forward,' Jul 14), so it would have been excluded anyway. Result: zero items pass verification today because the verification tool was unavailable for every board except Anthropic's static listing page, not because the market is empty.
